---
name: create-test-skeleton
description: Create empty Playwright JavaScript test skeletons from test scenarios, requirements, acceptance criteria, user stories, or manual test cases.
---

Create empty Playwright JavaScript test skeletons for the test scenarios, requirements, acceptance criteria, user story, or manual test cases I provide.

Use the **playwright-test-scaffolding** skill for the test scaffolding workflow.

Follow the applicable project Playwright instructions and existing framework conventions.

Inspect existing related tests, fixtures, naming conventions, grouping, and tagging conventions when available.

Create one empty Playwright test for each requested scenario unless the existing project structure requires otherwise.

Preserve provided scenario IDs, test titles, order, and tags.

Do not invent additional test scenarios.

Do not implement navigation, locators, actions, assertions, API calls, test data, authentication, network behavior, or other test logic.

Do not invent URLs, locators, credentials, test data, expected behavior, or application information.

Keep test bodies empty unless I explicitly request placeholder comments.

Do not add unnecessary imports or TODO comments.

Output only the requested Playwright test skeleton code. Do not include explanations, reasoning, summaries, alternatives, or additional commentary unless I explicitly request them.

If essential scenario information is missing, output only a concise request for the specific information needed.

Ask me to provide the test scenarios, requirements, acceptance criteria, user story, or manual test cases if I have not provided them.
